text:
maria gonzalez: Quick heads-up — planning a tiny PLG experiment (call it 'sparkdrop') to test launch post messaging + inbound routing + credit seeding + a short webinar. Goal: move signups to first meaningful action within 7 days. Thoughts?
jamal liu: Sounds good. Recommend we keep the sample small: 1k impressions, 250 credits seeded, and split two subject lines. Who owns routing?
maria gonzalez: @jamal can you own routing + cohort tagging? @avery will take copy. I can own webinar logistics.
jamal liu: Yep — I'll add a route that flags signups with `sparkdrop=true`. Proposed rule: 
```
if (utm_campaign == 'sparkdrop' && source == 'twitter') {
  route = 'sparkdrop-cohort';
  tag('sparkdrop_seeded');
}
```
leo nguyen: Landing page tweaks: 1) shorter hero, 2) one CTA for "Try prompt templates", 3) inline calendar CTA for webinar. I can ship a 1-pager this afternoon.
avery park: Copy direction: upbeat, trial-first, highlight "25 free credits + starter prompts". Subject line A: "Try Redwood: free credits + prompts" Subject B: "Ship an AI feature tonight — 25 credits inside"
sarah connor: Key metrics: signup -> first API call (48h), prompt-template use, webinar RSVP -> attendance. We should instrument a funnel in GA + internal dashboard. Also add an eval set for quality regressions tied to the template prompts.
jamal liu: Routing/tech notes: backend will set user.meta.sparksource = 'sparkdrop' and an event `sparkdrop_seeded`. I'll expose cohort_id `sparkdrop_v1`. Need product flag for credit grant (250 users).
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled campaign jobs require 48h lead time — set campaign start at least 2 business days after routing is configured.
maria gonzalez: Timeline proposal: prep Wed, soft launch Thurs 9am PT to 1k impressions, measure 72h, then scale if activation lift > 12%. Webinar Fri 11am PT — 20-min demo, 10-min Q&A.
ale: Wait typo?
leo nguyen: @maria small ask — can we use a short signup flow so prompt-template use happens inline? I can add a "use this prompt" button on success page.
avery park: I'll draft two short launch posts (twitter + linkedin) and 3 prompt templates for the webinar. Posting copy will include `?utm_campaign=sparkdrop` links.
sarah connor: For analysis: I'll track conversion by cohort_id and measure avg tokens per new user, first-24h retention, and prompt-template completion rate. If retention dips, pause credits.
maria gonzalez: Decision: go with both subject lines A/B, seed 250 users with 25 credits each (total 6250 tokens-ish), route to `sparkdrop_v1`. @jamal please add the cohort tag and credit grant. @avery pls drop draft copy by EOD. Ops-bot — schedule check 48h after launch. :rocket:
jamal liu: On it. I'll open a tiny PR for the routing rule and credit service.
avery park: Drafts incoming in an hour.
maria gonzalez: Great — keeping this tight. If the mini-launch is green, we scale to 10k impressions next week. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
